result.rationale: TXNM is the correct company, but Blackstone is not a current owner. Its separate $400 million PIPE was voided and fully unwound on 2026-07-22; the 100% take-private remains signed and pending. BETP IV is unsupported.

identityResolution.continuity: Same corporation; name changed 2024-08-02 without structural change.
identityResolution.formation: Incorporated in 2000; holding-company structure began in 2001. TXNM was not formed by a 2000 PNM/TNMP merger; TNMP was acquired later.
identityResolution.boundary: TXNM is the parent platform; PNM and TNMP are operating subsidiaries, not separate manager-level PortCos.

ownershipResolution.currentState: Public-company shareholders; no active Blackstone stake after 2026-07-22.
ownershipResolution.fundResolution: Remove BETP IV. Public disclosures identify Blackstone Infrastructure and Blackstone Infrastructure Partners L.P.; no specific final fund/account allocation is disclosed.

pendingTransactions.buyer: Troy ParentCo LLC, a Blackstone Infrastructure affiliate

operatingResolution.scope: Qualifying North American regulated-utility platform upon closing; pending PortCo transaction only as of the as-of date.
operatingResolution.operations: PNM generates, transmits and distributes electricity in New Mexico; TNMP transmits and distributes electricity in Texas.
operatingResolution.correction: Current core operations are electric, not electric and gas; legacy gas distribution was sold in 2008.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No closing, termination, competing sale, divestiture, transfer, bankruptcy or successor transaction found through 2026-08-19.
acquisitionExitCheck.expectedClosing: H1 2027 company estimate; not a legal closing date.
acquisitionExitCheck.pipe: Closed 2025-06-02; voided 2026-07-02; $400 million repaid and all shares canceled 2026-07-22.

milestones.event: Current legal entity incorporated; holding-company structure began in 2001.
PNM Resources renamed TXNM Energy with no structural change.
Blackstone take-private and separate $400 million PIPE announced.
PIPE repayment and cancellation completed; full acquisition remained pending.

result.recommendedListAction: ADD_PENDING_TRANSACTION; retain the TXNM record; remove active Blackstone ownership and BETP IV; retain the PIPE only as historical VOIDED_AND_UNWOUND; correct operating, headquarters and founding fields.
